name: cameractrl_svd

depth.note: CameraCtrl on SVD-XT does not consume the exported metric depth

normals.note: CameraCtrl on SVD-XT does not consume normals

motion.note: the exported motion vectors are not consumed; the camera path is the motion control

ids.note: CameraCtrl on SVD-XT does not consume object IDs

camera_pose.role: per-frame camera from the exported scene camera, relative to the first frame

reference_frames.role: exactly one RGB reference image is the first frame of the video; if omitted, the first ControlBundle beauty frame is used

seed.role: CUDA generator seed for the video

sampler_settings.role: steps, fps, motion_bucket_id, noise_aug_strength and translation_scale; unknown keys refused
sampler_settings.translation_scale: float above zero; multiplies the camera's travel before it reaches the model; the model's distance scale is its training data's, not the scene's. Default: a constant divided by the reference frame's median depth (1.0 when no depth pass is exported)

color: ACEScg beauty is converted through OCIO to an sRGB reference image; external references are RGB images. The model generates 576 by 320 sRGB frames, resized to the requested plate and converted through OCIO to ACEScg OpenEXR.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA CUDA with model CPU offload and chunked VAE decode
